title: Lavender Towel Bar, 18-Inch Wall Mount Powder Coated Iron Pipe-Style, Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
description: Towel bar, 18-inch wall mount, powder coated iron pipe-style straight bar for bathroom towel storage and everyday drying in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. Center-to-center: 18 in; overall dimensions: 18 x 3 x 3.3 in with 3.3 in projection; 0.75 in diameter bar. Industrial style hardware designed to coordinate with pipe-style bath accessories and loft bathroom fixtures. Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and color coordinated mounting hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Weight capacity 10 lb. Corrosion-free and rust-free performance with a highly durable powder coat; assembly not required. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Pipeline collection.
